original_test_intent: Verify the owner-approved population of STATUS records, their descriptions and decoded health states across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the component health specification.
original_method: Enumerate every included STATUS record rather than treating the item title as a sensor; bind each record to a component or health function; retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web rows; compare record type, raw and decoded state, description, thresholds and freshness while preserving fault history.
manual_activity: The owner defines the STATUS inclusion list, per-record component and state semantics and resolves criteria 3–70; an operator reviews the Web states, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact STATUS record inclusion list and record IDs/types
Per-record component/health-function map, raw-bit decoding and acceptable states
Protected access and complete Web evidence
Preserved component-status/SEL context and criteria 3–70 decision
safety_requirements: Use read-only queries with protected credentials
Do not clear component, BMC, status or SEL evidence
Do not treat broad grep results as an approved population or the item label as a sensor
Retain complete lists and raw states
Stop on critical, failed or unknown state, duplicate/missing record, identity mismatch or channel disagreement
agent_execution_scope: Bind only the row-2032 variant and keep the row-1194 SEL case separate
Collect complete read-only IB/OOB lists and Web evidence
Apply the approved inclusion and state map per record
Report missing/extra/duplicate/stale or inconsistent health states
Perform no status write, inclusion decision, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve STATUS population, component map and state decoding
Resolve criteria-number gap and treatment of unknown/critical states
Review per-record three-surface evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Status Check - STATUS'` invents a record not present in the source and the truncated fallback omits the population and Web view.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, enumerate exact owner-approved STATUS records, capture all corresponding Web rows and compare raw/decoded states by component.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The broad STATUS source scope, both IB/OOB list checks, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; row 1194 is not merged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-record matrix of record ID/type, component, raw state, decoded state and timestamp across IB/OOB/Web.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit inclusion and decoding without changing any state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One synthetic query can hide missing components, duplicate aliases or critical discrete states in the broad population.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different surfaces may cache or translate discrete states; raw values and aligned timestamps are required.

All included raw and decoded records plus complete Web rows
Missing/extra/duplicate/stale analysis, preserved component/SEL context, criteria decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: STATUS is an undefined broad filter, criteria jump from 2 to 71, and log clearing could erase relevant faults. DeepSeek replaces the population with one synthetic label; the same code also names an unrelated row-1194 SEL testcase.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive collection is feasible; inclusion, decoding, mapping and source clarification are supplyable owner inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2032 variant ce41ec26bca184f9 of shared code Wistron-BMC-00484-V003: define the exact STATUS record population, record types, component/health mapping and raw-to-decoded acceptable states; confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 71 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–70 are missing, while keeping row 1194 Get SEL Allocation Info (OOB) strictly separate and preserving status/SEL evidence.

review_improvement: Enumerates the status population, requires record-aware state decoding, preserves fault context and isolates the unrelated shared-code variant.
independent_technical_reasoning: STATUS is only a substring and may match many discrete records with different bit meanings and component scopes. A generic item label cannot represent that set, and comparing display strings without raw states can conceal translation errors. The duplicate code makes row and variant binding essential because SEL allocation capacity is unrelated to current component health.
